distinctStates.inventoryWorkingSet: scope/query/map snapshot; controls which rows Browse displays.
distinctStates.inventoryEditSelection: ephemeral IDs chosen for a staged multi-edit; presentation/edit state only.
distinctStates.inspectedCell: selectedMapCellId; read-only map context owned by the inspector.
distinctStates.activeTransmitter: selectedTower; Single-mode RF input and shared map context.

browseRowAction: Open exact detail by setting inventoryTargetCellId only.
mapSelectionAction: The Network empty-state action changes planningMode to Network and arms Select cells but deliberately does not add selectedTower to Network membership.
directInspectorHandoff: Exact Cell target; does not change active transmitter, Network, Map Focus, or compute work.
contextReset: Clear detail and local edit/browse session when active Project, Scenario, or dataset revision changes.
